english.meaning: adj. 有韧性的；能迅速恢复的
english.example: She is resilient enough to bounce back from failure.
english.quizQuestion: Children are remarkably _____ and adapt quickly to new environments.

english.meaning: adj. 一丝不苟的；细致的
english.example: He is meticulous in his research.
english.quizQuestion: The report was prepared with _____ attention to detail.

english.meaning: adj. 普遍存在的；无所不在的
english.example: Mobile phones have become ubiquitous in modern life.
english.quizQuestion: Coffee shops have become _____ in most major cities around the world.

english.content: 虚拟语气：If I were you, I would...
english.meaning: 与现在事实相反的虚拟语气，be动词统一用were
english.example: If I were you, I would take the job offer.
english.quizQuestion: If I _____ you, I would apologize immediately.

english.content: 倒装句：Only after... did I realize...
english.meaning: only+状语置于句首时，主句部分倒装
english.example: Only after I left did I realize how much I missed her.
english.quizQuestion: Only after the meeting _____ that the plan had failed.
english.quizAnswer: did he realize（倒装句助动词提前）

english.content: It is high time that we took action on climate change.
english.meaning: 强调句型，high time后用一般过去时表示'该做某事了'
english.example: It is high time that you started your own business.
english.quizQuestion: It is high time that we _____ (take) measures to protect wildlife.

editing.title: 波纹扭曲转场 氛围感神技
editing.content: Pr用户：效果面板搜'波纹扭曲'，开头幅度0、中间峰值15-25、结尾归0；剪映：搜'波纹扭曲转场'强度30-40%。
editing.notes: 适合婚礼快剪、氛围视频，新手最易忘记结尾归位导致画面一直晃。

editing.title: 剪映/PR淡入淡出转场三种方法
editing.content: 剪映用'淡化'滑块或画中画+不透明度关键帧；PR用交叉溶解或双轨不透明度叠加。
editing.notes: V1视频淡出终点必须早于V2视频淡入起点，否则会叠加过曝，注意轨对齐。

editing.title: 混剪转场三件套 遮罩/定格/音画错位
editing.content: 遮罩转场做放大镜效果、帧定格转场做成长回忆、音画错位转场做叙事感。
editing.notes: 燃向卡点：70%硬切+20%动作匹配+10%闪白；情感向：60%叠化+20%色彩匹配+15%动作匹配。

editing.title: 3步做出百万播放卡点视频
editing.content: 选带鼓点热歌→素材动作暴击排列（转身甩头撩发）→加光影粒子或故障特效。
editing.notes: 第3秒加'灵魂出窍'特效完播率提升200%，全片必须卡在音乐重音上。

editing.title: 千万点赞视频BGM选择三大法则
editing.content: 情绪共振（美食配爵士/情感配钢琴）+节奏卡点（动作对准鼓点）+热点借势（截取副歌20秒变速）。
editing.notes: 张同学乡村视频用年代民谣破1500万赞，舞蹈账号动作卡点破2300万赞。

editing.title: 抖音爆款5步爆破公式
editing.content: 反常识钩子→洋葱式结构（前3s悬念/15s反转/30s价值）→BGM情绪开关→三环文案→时段流量折叠。
editing.notes: 故意留1个明显错误引导纠错，单条视频可涨评3000+；红底黄字统一封面推荐+40%。
